    elseif n == 1
        return Int64[inst.V_p[1]]
    end

    e_vals = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    tw_vals = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    span_vals = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    q_vals = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    min_e, max_e = Inf, -Inf
    min_tw, max_tw = Inf, -Inf
    min_span, max_span = Inf, -Inf
    min_q, max_q = Inf, -Inf

    for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        d = inst.V_d[k]

        ep = Float64(inst.e[p])
        lp = Float64(inst.l[p])
        ed = Float64(inst.e[d])
        ld = Float64(inst.l[d])
        qp = Float64(inst.q[p])

        tw = (lp - ep) + (ld - ed)
        span = ld - ep

        min_e = min(min_e, ep)
        max_e = max(max_e, ep)
        min_tw = min(min_tw, tw)
        max_tw = max(max_tw, tw)
        min_span = min(min_span, span)
        max_span = max(max_span, span)
        min_q = min(min_q, qp)
        max_q = max(max_q, qp)

        e_vals[k] = ep
        tw_vals[k] = tw
        span_vals[k] = span
        q_vals[k] = qp
    end

    range_e = max(max_e - min_e, 1e-6)
    range_tw = max(max_tw - min_tw, 1e-6)
    range_span = max(max_span - min_span, 1e-6)
    range_q = max(max_q - min_q, 1e-6)

    w_e = rand(params.rng, Float64) * 2.0 + 0.2
    w_tw = rand(params.rng, Float64) * 2.0 + 0.2
    w_span = rand(params.rng, Float64) * 1.0 + 0.1
    w_q = rand(params.rng, Float64) * 1.0 + 0.1
    noise_scale = rand(params.rng, Float64) * 0.8 + 0.1

    scores = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    for k in 1:n
        norm_e = (e_vals[k] - min_e) / range_e
        norm_tw = (tw_vals[k] - min_tw) / range_tw
        norm_span = (span_vals[k] - min_span) / range_span
        norm_q = (q_vals[k] - min_q) / range_q

        noise = rand(params.rng, Float64)
        scores[k] = w_e * norm_e + w_tw * norm_tw + w_span * norm_span - w_q * norm_q + noise_scale * noise
    end

    perm = sortperm(scores)
    result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    for k in 1:n
        result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[perm[k]])
    end
    return result
end

function llm_candidate_score(inst::InstanceData, params::ParameterData)::Vector{Int64}

    end

    tw_p = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    dist_pd = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    cross_floor = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    demand = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        d = inst.V_d[k]

        jp = inst.jobs[p]
        jd = inst.jobs[d]

        ep = Float64(inst.e[p])
        lp = Float64(inst.l[p])

        e_p[k] = ep
        tw_p[k] = max(0.0, lp - ep)

        dx = Float64(jp.x - jd.x)
        dy = Float64(jp.y - jd.y)
        dist_pd[k] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

        cross_floor[k] = (jp.floor != jd.floor) ? 1.0 : 0.0
        demand[k] = Float64(inst.q[p])
    end

    function norm_vec!(v::Vector{Float64})
        min_v = minimum(v)
        max_v = maximum(v)
        rng = max_v - min_v
        if rng > 1e-9
            for i in 1:length(v)
                v[i] = (v[i] - min_v) / rng
            end
        else
            fill!(v, 0.0)
        end
    end

    norm_vec!(e_p)
    norm_vec!(tw_p)
    norm_vec!(dist_pd)
    norm_vec!(demand)

    w_ep = 1.0 + rand(params.rng) * 2.0
    w_cross = -0.8 - rand(params.rng) * 1.2
    w_tw = (rand(params.rng) - 0.3) * 1.0
    w_dist = (rand(params.rng) - 0.5) * 1.0
    w_q = -rand(params.rng) * 0.8

    noise_weight = 0.15 + rand(params.rng) * 0.70

    scores = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    for k in 1:n
        base_s = w_ep * e_p[k] + w_cross * cross_floor[k] + w_tw * tw_p[k] + w_dist * dist_pd[k] + w_q * demand[k]
        u = max(1e-6, min(1.0 - 1e-6, rand(params.rng)))
        gumbel_noise = -log(-log(u))
        scores[k] = base_s + noise_weight * gumbel_noise
    end

    perm = sortperm(scores)
    return Vector{Int64}(inst.V_p[perm])

    n_tw_d = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    n_q    = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    r = max_v - min_v
    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        n_ep[k] = r > 1e-9 ? (ep_vec[k] - min_v) / r : 0.0
    end

    min_v, max_v = extrema(ld_vec)

    @inbounds for k in 1:n

    end

    min_v, max_v = extrema(q_vec)
    r = max_v - min_v
    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        n_q[k] = r > 1e-9 ? (q_vec[k] - min_v) / r : 0.0
    end

    w_ep   = rand(rng) < 0.85 ? (0.2 + 1.8 * rand(rng)) : 0.0
    w_ld   = rand(rng) < 0.65 ? (0.1 + 1.2 * rand(rng)) : 0.0
    w_tw_p = rand(rng) < 0.60 ? (0.1 + 1.0 * rand(rng)) : 0.0
    w_tw_d = rand(rng) < 0.50 ? (0.1 + 0.8 * rand(rng)) : 0.0
    w_dist = rand(rng) < 0.50 ? (0.8 * (rand(rng) - 0.5)) : 0.0
    w_q    = rand(rng) < 0.40 ? (-0.8 * rand(rng)) : 0.0

    tau = 0.05 + 0.6 * rand(rng)

    scores = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        base_score = w_ep * n_ep[k] +

                     w_tw_d * n_tw_d[k] +
                     w_dist * n_dist[k] +

        u_clamped = u < 1e-9 ? 1e-9 : (u > 1.0 - 1e-9 ? 1.0 - 1e-9 : u)

        scores[k] = base_score + tau * gumbel_noise
    end

    perm = sortperm(scores)
    return Vector{Int64}(inst.V_p[perm])

function llm_candidate_score(inst::InstanceData, params::ParameterData)::Vector{Int64}

    end

    rng = params.rng

    tw_p = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    tw_d = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    slack_pd = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    q_vec = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    dist_pd = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    cross_fl = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        d = inst.V_d[k]

        e_p = Float64(inst.e[p])
        l_p = Float64(inst.l[p])
        e_d = Float64(inst.e[d])
        l_d = Float64(inst.l[d])

        ep[k] = e_p
        tw_p[k] = l_p - e_p
        tw_d[k] = l_d - e_d
        slack_pd[k] = l_d - e_p
        q_vec[k] = Float64(inst.q[p])

        p_job = inst.jobs[p]
        d_job = inst.jobs[d]

        px = hasproperty(p_job, :x) ? Float64(p_job.x) : Float64(p_job.pos.x)
        py = hasproperty(p_job, :y) ? Float64(p_job.y) : Float64(p_job.pos.y)
        pf = hasproperty(p_job, :floor) ? Float64(p_job.floor) : Float64(p_job.pos.floor)

        dx = hasproperty(d_job, :x) ? Float64(d_job.x) : Float64(d_job.pos.x)
        dy = hasproperty(d_job, :y) ? Float64(d_job.y) : Float64(d_job.pos.y)
        df = hasproperty(d_job, :floor) ? Float64(d_job.floor) : Float64(d_job.pos.floor)

        dist_pd[k] = sqrt((px - dx)^2 + (py - dy)^2)
        cross_fl[k] = (pf != df) ? 1.0 : 0.0
    end

    function norm_v(v::Vector{Float64})
        mn, mx = extrema(v)
        rg = mx - mn
        return rg < 1e-9 ? zeros(Float64, length(v)) : (v .- mn) ./ rg
    end

    n_ep = norm_v(ep)
    n_tw_p = norm_v(tw_p)
    n_tw_d = norm_v(tw_d)
    n_slack = norm_v(slack_pd)
    n_q = norm_v(q_vec)
    n_dist = norm_v(dist_pd)
    n_cross = norm_v(cross_fl)

    strat = rand(rng)
    noise_amp = 0.05 + 0.20 * rand(rng)

    scores = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    if strat < 0.35
        w_ep = 0.5 + 0.5 * rand(rng)
        w_tw = 0.2 + 0.3 * rand(rng)
        w_cf = -0.3 * rand(rng)
        for k in 1:n
            scores[k] = w_ep * n_ep[k] + w_tw * (n_tw_p[k] + n_tw_d[k]) * 0.5 + w_cf * n_cross[k] + noise_amp * rand(rng)
        end
    elseif strat < 0.65
        w_cf = -0.4 * rand(rng)
        w_q = -0.3 * rand(rng)
        w_slack = 0.3 * rand(rng)
        w_dist = -0.2 * rand(rng)
        w_ep = 0.3 * rand(rng)
        for k in 1:n
            scores[k] = w_cf * n_cross[k] + w_q * n_q[k] + w_slack * n_slack[k] + w_dist * n_dist[k] + w_ep * n_ep[k] + noise_amp * rand(rng)
        end
    elseif strat < 0.85
        w1 = (rand(rng) - 0.5) * 2.0
        w2 = (rand(rng) - 0.5) * 2.0
        w3 = (rand(rng) - 0.5) * 2.0
        w4 = (rand(rng) - 0.5) * 2.0
        w5 = (rand(rng) - 0.5) * 2.0
        for k in 1:n

        end
    else
        for k in 1:n
            scores[k] = rand(rng)
        end
    end

    perm = sortperm(scores)

        dy = Float64(job_p.point.y - job_d.point.y)
        dist[k] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

        inter_island[k] = (job_p.point.z != job_d.point.z) ? 1.0 : 0.0
        demand[k] = Float64(inst.q[p])
    end

    normalize = (arr) -> begin
        mn, mx = extrema(arr)
        rng = mx - mn
        if rng < 1e-9
            return zeros(Float64, length(arr))
        else
            return (arr .- mn) ./ rng
        end
    end

    norm_ld = normalize(l_d)
    norm_tw = normalize(tw_sum)
    norm_dist = normalize(dist)

                     w_ld * (1.0 - norm_ld[k]) +
                     w_tw * (1.0 - norm_tw[k]) +
                     w_island * inter_island[k] +
                     w_dist * norm_dist[k] +
                     w_dem * norm_dem[k]

        noise = 1.0 + (rand(params.rng) - 0.5) * 0.3

function llm_candidate_score(inst::InstanceData, params::ParameterData)::Vector{Int64}
    n = inst.n
    if n <= 1
        return copy(inst.V_p)
    end

    px = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    py = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    pz = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    dx = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    dy = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    dz = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    ep = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    ld = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        d = inst.V_d[k]
        jp = inst.jobs[p]
        jd = inst.jobs[d]

        px[k] = Float64(jp.point.x)
        py[k] = Float64(jp.point.y)
        pz[k] = jp.point.z

        dx[k] = Float64(jd.point.x)
        dy[k] = Float64(jd.point.y)
        dz[k] = jd.point.z

        ep[k] = inst.e[p]
        ld[k] = inst.l[d]
    end

    unvisited = collect(1:n)
    order = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)

    # Start with requests having the earliest pickup time
    sort!(unvisited, by = k -> ep[k] + rand(params.rng) * 5.0)
    current_k = popfirst!(unvisited)
    order[1] = current_k

    curr_x = dx[current_k]
    curr_y = dy[current_k]
    curr_z = dz[current_k]
    curr_t = max(ep[current_k], inst.e[inst.V_d[current_k]])

    for step in 2:n
        rem_len = length(unvisited)
        costs = Vector{Float64}(undef, rem_len)

        for i in 1:rem_len
            k = unvisited[i]
            dist_xy = sqrt((px[k] - curr_x)^2 + (py[k] - curr_y)^2)
            z_penalty = (pz[k] != curr_z) ? 50.0 : 0.0
            time_diff = max(0.0, ep[k] - curr_t)
            tw_span = ld[k] - ep[k]

            c = dist_xy + z_penalty + 0.5 * time_diff + 0.2 * tw_span
            c *= (0.85 + 0.3 * rand(params.rng))
            costs[i] = c
        end

        if rem_len <= 3
            best_i = argmin(costs)
        else
            p = sortperm(costs)
            r = rand(params.rng)
            if r < 0.6
                best_i = p[1]
            elseif r < 0.9
                best_i = p[2]
            else
                best_i = p[3]
            end
        end

        next_k = unvisited[best_i]
        order[step] = next_k
        deleteat!(unvisited, best_i)

        curr_x = dx[next_k]
        curr_y = dy[next_k]
        curr_z = dz[next_k]
        curr_t = max(ep[next_k], inst.e[inst.V_d[next_k]])
    end

    result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    for i in 1:n

    ld = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    dist_pd = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        d = inst.V_d[k]
        jp = inst.jobs[p]
        jd = inst.jobs[d]

        pz[k] = jp.point.z
        px[k] = Float64(jp.point.x)
        py[k] = Float64(jp.point.y)
        dx[k] = Float64(jd.point.x)
        dy[k] = Float64(jd.point.y)

        ep[k] = inst.e[p]
        ld[k] = inst.l[d]
        dist_pd[k] = sqrt((px[k] - dx[k])^2 + (py[k] - dy[k])^2)
    end

    unique_z = unique(pz)
    z_min_ep = Dict{Int64, Float64}()
    z_cx = Dict{Int64, Float64}()
    z_cy = Dict{Int64, Float64}()
    z_count = Dict{Int64, Int64}()

    for z in unique_z
        z_min_ep[z] = Inf
        z_cx[z] = 0.0
        z_cy[z] = 0.0
        z_count[z] = 0
    end

    for k in 1:n
        z = pz[k]
        if ep[k] < z_min_ep[z]
            z_min_ep[z] = ep[k]
        end
        z_cx[z] += px[k]
        z_cy[z] += py[k]
        z_count[z] += 1
    end

    for z in unique_z
        cnt = z_count[z]
        if cnt > 0
            z_cx[z] /= cnt
            z_cy[z] /= cnt
        end
    end

    mode = rand(params.rng, 1:3)
    scores = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    if mode == 1
        z_perturb = Dict{Int64, Float64}()
        for z in unique_z
            z_perturb[z] = z_min_ep[z] + rand(params.rng) * 20.0
        end

        angle_offset = rand(params.rng) * 2.0 * pi

        for k in 1:n
            z = pz[k]
            ang = atan(py[k] - z_cy[z], px[k] - z_cx[z]) + angle_offset
            tw_span = ld[k] - ep[k]
            scores[k] = z_perturb[z] * 10000.0 + ep[k] * 10.0 + 0.1 * tw_span + sin(ang) * 5.0 + rand(params.rng) * 2.0
        end
    elseif mode == 2
        for k in 1:n
            urgency = ld[k] - dist_pd[k]
            scores[k] = urgency - 0.5 * dist_pd[k] + rand(params.rng) * 10.0
        end
    else
        angle_offset = rand(params.rng) * 2.0 * pi
        for k in 1:n
            z = pz[k]
            ang = atan(py[k] - z_cy[z], px[k] - z_cx[z]) + angle_offset
            slack = ld[k] - ep[k] - dist_pd[k]
            scores[k] = ep[k] + 0.2 * slack + 2.0 * sin(ang) + rand(params.rng) * 5.0
        end
    end

    order = sortperm(scores)
    return inst.V_p[order]
end
